findings.problem: Electron Builder writes generated packages to dist-installers, but that directory is not ignored alongside dist, dist-desktop, dist-electron, and dist-ssr. Successful packaging will leave large native artifacts as unignored workspace output.
findings.proposed_fix: Add dist-installers/ to .gitignore and optionally assert in the focused packaging test that the configured output directory is covered by generated-output policy.

findings.problem: The test meaningfully validates static targets, architectures, resources, scripts, and naming for macOS, Linux, and Windows, but it never builds or inspects a native package. The governed smoke is explicitly web-baseline evidence, so there is still no executable proof of package production, installation, or packaged launch on any target platform.
findings.proposed_fix: Retain the static regression test and add native-host packaging jobs or governed artifact evidence for macOS, Linux, and Windows, including the documented install, launch, offline editor, native file, export, link, and notice checks.

checks_run.summary: Compiled the governed smoke checker successfully with quiet output; the command emitted no text and any bytecode remained under scripts/__pycache__/.

cross-platform installer configuration.justification: The repair declares coherent unsigned macOS arm64/x64 DMG and ZIP, Linux x64 AppImage, and Windows x64 NSIS and portable targets, with publishing disabled and collision-free Windows artifact names.

Electron and drawDB preservation.justification: The existing Electron main/preload build, isolated and sandboxed runtime, local editor route, and separate ordinary web build remain intact; governed web smoke reports startup and core-flow success without blocking errors.

offline desktop constraints.justification: Relative renderer assets and Electron loadFile startup avoid Python, Vite preview, localhost, and any packaged runtime server dependency.

lockfile reproducibility.justification: package-lock.json matches the root electron-builder declaration and contains the resolved 26.15.3 package, dependency graph, integrity metadata, and executable mapping.

generated-output handling.justification: The intermediate build directories are ignored, but the configured native installer output directory is omitted from .gitignore.

test and smoke adequacy.justification: The focused suite provides useful static coverage of all three platform configurations, while the manifest and plans correctly identify the supplied smoke as web-only and native artifact smoke as pending.

review environment.justification: The workspace is not exposed as a functional Git worktree and its current node_modules install lacks the locked builder executable; neither limitation demonstrates a source defect in the repaired lockfile or configuration.
